data.what_it_does: A Shelf middleware to add CORS headers to shelf responses. It handles preflight requests, allows overriding default headers, and supports custom origin checker functions.
use_when: You are building a Shelf backend that needs to handle CORS headers for web clients.
You need to handle preflight requests automatically in a Shelf application.
avoid_when: You are not using the Shelf package for your backend/server.
strengths: Allows custom origin checkers such as originOneOf
Easy to integrate into the Shelf Pipeline
